name: des_s3_slstr_l2lst
title: Sentinel-3 SLSTR Land Surface Temperature (daytime)
abstract: Daytime Land Surface Temperature in Kelvin from Sentinel-3 SLSTR Level-2 LST (SL_2_LST), on the SWEREF 99 TM tile grid at 1 km. Night-time overpasses and cloudy pixels are masked out using the confidence_in flags.
